generate_text_only_prompt: use PromptGeneratorText to generate a text-only prompt from a template and game short name
validate_prompt_template: use PromptGeneratorImageText to check if a prompt template is valid for image text generation
generate_image_text_prompt: use PromptGeneratorImageText to generate a multimodal prompt with board image and text from a game adapter
implement_prompt_generator_protocol: implement the PromptGeneratorSupportsText protocol to create a custom text-only prompt generator class
implement_image_text_protocol: implement the PromptGeneratorSupportsImageText protocol to create a custom image and text prompt generator class
